topic: Getting the Wrong Dish at a Sit-Down

script.title: THE WRONG STEAK
script.story_hook: A hungry diner gets the wrong steak.
script.intro_zh: 飢腸轆轆的食客，上的卻是錯的牛排。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a wrong dish needs fixing. Listen for polite complaints and options.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天來處理上錯菜。留意有禮貌的抱怨與提案問句。
script.outro: Full table, happy guest. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 吃飽的桌子，開心的客人。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each restaurant phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀餐廳常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a college-age young man with a short buzz cut, wearing a gray hoodie over a plain white tee, dark jeans and running shoes, thin build, looking very hungry
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman in her fifties with short silver hair, wearing a burgundy server apron over a white blouse, black pants and comfy shoes, sturdy build, holding a notepad

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, hi — this isn't my order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi haɪ ðɪs ˈɪzənt maɪ ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這……好像不是我點的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh? What did you have, honey?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wʌt dɪd ju hæv ˈhʌni/
dialogue.zh: 喔？您點的是哪一道？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The number six, sirloin, well done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnʌmbɚ sɪks ˈsɜɹloɪn wɛl dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 六號，沙朗牛排，要全熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well done… let me check the ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl dʌn lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə ˈtɪkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 全熟……我核對一下單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one's still pink in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌnz stɪl pɪŋk ɪn ðə ˈmɪdl̩/
dialogue.zh: 這塊中間還是粉紅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're right. That's medium-rare, sorry!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɹaɪt ðæts ˈmidɪəm ɹɛɹ ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 您說得對，這是五分熟，抱歉！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't eat it like this, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt it ɪt laɪk ðɪs ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，這樣我沒法吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally fair. I'll send it right back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtli fɛɹ aɪl sɛnd ɪt ɹaɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 應該的。我馬上送回廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how long for a fresh one?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ lɔŋ fɔɹ ə fɹɛʃ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，重新做一塊要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes. Does that work for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈmɪnəts dʌz ðæt wɜɹk fɔɹ ju/
dialogue.zh: 十二分鐘。這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kind of. My friend arrives at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd əv maɪ fɹɛnd əˈɹaɪvz æt ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 勉強可以。我朋友七點會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's do this — switch to chicken?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts du ðɪs swɪtʃ tu ˈtʃɪkɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那我提個方案——換成雞肉如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The grilled one? That's faster, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɹɪld wʌn ðæts ˈfæstɚ ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 烤雞那款？那個比較快，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, max, and it's excellent.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnəts mæks ænd ɪts ˈɛksələnt/
dialogue.zh: 最多六分鐘，而且非常好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, you know best. Chicken it is.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ju noʊ bɛst ˈtʃɪkɪn ɪt ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好，你最有經驗——就雞肉吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want any sides moved to the chicken?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ˈɛni saɪdz muvd tu ðə ˈtʃɪkɪn/
dialogue.zh: 配菜要跟著換到雞肉那邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mashed potatoes, if they're still warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæʃt pəˈteɪtoʊz ɪf ðɛɹ stɪl wɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 馬鈴薯泥還熱的話，就要它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Made one minute ago, fresh off the stove.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪd wʌn ˈmɪnɪt əˈɡoʊ fɹɛʃ ɑf ðə stoʊv/
dialogue.zh: 一分鐘前剛做好，還熱騰騰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. And could I get more water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ænd kʊd aɪ ɡɛt mɔɹ ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。能再給我一點水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming right up. Save your seat!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ ɹaɪt ʌp seɪv jʊɹ sit/
dialogue.zh: 馬上來，坐著別動！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — one small thing about the bread.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌn smɑl θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə bɹɛd/
dialogue.zh: 等等——麵包有點小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes? Did we bring the wrong kind?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dɪd wi bɹɪŋ ðə ɹɔŋ kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯？我們上錯品種了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend can't do dairy, just so you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fɹɛnd kænt du ˈdɛɹi dʒʌst soʊ ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 先說一聲，我朋友不吃乳製品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! The garlic butter has dairy in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə ˈɡɑɹlɪk ˈbʌtɚ hæz ˈdɛɹi ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 啊！這蒜味奶油裡有乳製品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah… any chance of olive oil instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ ˈɛni tʃæns əv ˈɑlɪv ɔɪl ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 呃……能換成橄欖油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Olive oil and warm bread, done deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑlɪv ɔɪl ænd wɔɹm bɹɛd dʌn diːl/
dialogue.zh: 橄欖油配熱麵包，成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're saving my evening, for real.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈseɪvɪŋ maɪ ˈivnɪŋ fɔɹ ɹiəl/
dialogue.zh: 你真的救了我今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the least the kitchen can do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə list ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn kæn du/
dialogue.zh: 這是廚房該做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, while I wait — how's the soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm waɪl aɪ weɪt haʊz ðə sup/
dialogue.zh: 那我在等的時候——湯怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clam chowder today. It's famous here.
dialogue.phonetic: /klæm ˈtʃaʊdɚ təˈdeɪ ɪts ˈfeɪməs hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 今天是蛤蜊巧達湯，很有名的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Famous? Okay, sell me on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfeɪməs oʊˈkeɪ sɛl mi ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有名？好啊，說服我點它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Creamy, with bacon on top. No shells.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɹimɪ wɪð ˈbeɪkɑn ɑn tɑp noʊ ʃɛlz/
dialogue.zh: 濃濃的，上面有培根。沒有殼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold! A small bowl, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld ə smɑl boʊl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 成交！來一小碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One chowder, one chicken, potatoes, oil, water.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈtʃaʊdɚ wʌn ˈtʃɪkɪn pəˈteɪtoʊz ɔɪl ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一份巧達湯、一份雞肉、馬鈴薯、油、水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You repeat orders better than my mom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɹɪˈpit ˈɔɹdɚz ˈbɛtɚ ðən maɪ mɑm/
dialogue.zh: 你複述點單比我媽還厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Twenty years of practice, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈtwɛnti jɪɹz əv ˈpɹæktɪs ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！練了二十年啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty? You look way younger than that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ju lʊk weɪ ˈjʌŋgɚ ðən ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 二十年？你看起來年輕多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice words like that get free dessert here.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wɜɹdz laɪk ðæt ɡɛt fɹi dɪˈzɜɹt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 會說這種好話，就有免費甜點哦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a rule? I'll take the pie.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə ɹul aɪl teɪk ðə paɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是規矩嗎？那來一份派。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoot! Apple's gone. Peach is what's left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃut ˈæpl̩z ɡɑn pitʃ ɪz wʌts lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 不巧！蘋果派賣完了，只剩水蜜桃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peach sounds lovely. I'll take it after.
dialogue.phonetic: /pitʃ saʊndz ˈlʌvli aɪl teɪk ɪt ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 水蜜桃聽起來不錯，我飯後再吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saved on the ticket. Napkins, fresh fork?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd ɑn ðə ˈtɪkɪt ˈnæpkɪnz fɹɛɹ fɔɹk/
dialogue.zh: 單子上記好了。餐巾、新叉子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. My fork slid under the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz maɪ fɔɹk slɪd ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈteɪbəl̩/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩了，我的叉子掉到桌下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go. Anything else right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ɛls ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 給你。現在還要別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope. I'm good. Where is that soup, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp aɪm ɡʊd wɛɹ ɪz ðæt sup ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不用了。對了，那碗湯呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here! Two minutes late, sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹ tu ˈmɪnəts leɪt sɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡！晚了兩分鐘，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no — bacon landed in my water!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ˈbeɪkɑn ˈlændɪd ɪn maɪ ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不——培根掉進我的水杯了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Disaster? I'll swap the glass, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dɪˈzæstɚ aɪl swɑp ðə ɡlæs ˈpɹɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈！算災難嗎？我馬上換杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New glass, please. I'll survive, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ɡlæs pliz aɪl sɚˈvaɪv aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 新杯子就好。我撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh water, fresh bacon. All handled.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹɛʃ ˈwɔɾɚ fɹɛʃ ˈbeɪkɑn ɑl ˈhændəld/
dialogue.zh: 新水、新培根，都搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chicken was worth the whole switch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈtʃɪkɪn wʌz wɜɹθ ðə hoʊl swɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 這雞肉值得我換整桌菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Told you. The kitchen sends their regards.
dialogue.phonetic: /toʊld ju ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn sɛndz ðɛɹ ɹɪˈɡɑɹdz/
dialogue.zh: 早說了吧。廚房向你問好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what happened to that pink steak?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt ˈhæpənd tu ðæt pɪŋk steɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那塊粉紅牛排後來怎麼樣了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chef re-cooked it. Boxed, for later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛf ɹiˈkʊkt ɪt bɑkst fɔɹ ˈleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 師傅回鍋煎全熟，裝盒給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, I get the steak too? Seriously?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt aɪ ɡɛt ðə steɪk tu ˈsɪɹəsli/
dialogue.zh: 等等，牛排我也能拿走？真的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: House rule: our mistakes become your lunches.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊs ɹul ˈaʊɚ mɪsˈteɪks bɪˈkʌm jʊɹ ˈlʌntʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 店裡規矩：我們的失誤變你的加菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then check, please. I'd like to pay now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃɛk pliz aɪd laɪk tu peɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那請結帳吧，我想現在付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's ten percent off, from the house today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tɛn pɚˈsɛnt ɑf fɹʌm ðə haʊs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天已經打了九折，由本店招待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly? Best service I've had all year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli bɛst ˈsɜɹvɪs aɪv hæd ɑl jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，這是今年最好的服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ahh, thank you! Enjoy that peach pie!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ θæŋk ju ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðæt pitʃ paɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，謝謝你！慢慢享用水蜜桃派！

script.youtube_title_en: "Sell Me On It" — Getting the Wrong Dish at a Sit-Down
script.youtube_description:
60句餐廳上錯菜聽力練習：牛排點全熟卻上了五分熟，怎麼開口、怎麼換菜、怎麼把不愉快的一餐變成加分服務？

這一集跟著飢腸轆轆的食客，從核對單子開始，學會描述熟度、提出換菜、照顧朋友的飲食禁忌，還有一碗有名的蛤蜊巧達湯，以及培根掉進水杯的小意外。

你會聽到：
- 有禮貌的抱怨句式：「This isn't my order.」
- 換菜與時間的提案問句：「Switch to chicken?」
- 飲食禁忌的說法：「My friend can't do dairy.」
- 結帳與打折的禮貌用語

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of restaurant listening practice: a hungry diner ordered the sirloin well-done and got a pink medium-rare steak instead, so the server turns the mistake around with a quick switch to chicken, a dairy mix-up with the garlic butter, a famous clam chowder, and a bacon-in-the-water mishap.

You will hear polite complaints, swap suggestions, food-preference phrases, and how the bill gets handled at the end. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.
